Subject: [Perl Jobs] Part time developer for domain registrar (onsite), Australia, Victoria, Melbourne

Online URL for this job: http://jobs.perl.org/job/7946

To subscribe to this list, send mail to jobs-subscribe@perl.org.
To unsubscribe, send mail to jobs-unsubscribe@perl.org.

Posted: February 14, 2008

Job title: Part time developer for domain registrar

Company name: Distribute IT

Location: Australia, Victoria, Melbourne

Travel: 0%

Terms of employment: Hourly employee

Hours: Part time

Onsite: yes

Description:
* BRW Fast 100 in 2007 
* Part time role
* Docklands location

Formed in 2000, Distribute.IT Pty Ltd has built an enviable reputation for
being one of the longest running and fastest growing online services
providers in Australia.  With expertise in the delivery of online,
web-based products and services.

As a result of continuing fast growth, we are looking for motivated people
to fill several new roles in our development team. This role requires a
part-time programmer to assist with ongoing development of our range of
technical systems and solutions.

This position would suit current tertiary students or recent graduates,
seeking a part-time role in a fast-paced IT company, wanting to gain
valuable industry experience and contribute to the development of new
solutions.


Required skills:
- Perl - object oriented and procedural styles (essential)
- mySQL
- Strong Linux knowledge (Debian and Mandriva)
- Web apps and batch processes


Desired skills:
- RPC, Web services and EPP
- Knowledge of the SDLC (design, unit testing etc)
- Revision control (SVN, or CVS etc)
- MVC frameworks (Catalyst, CGI::App)


Contact information at:
http://jobs.perl.org/job/7946#contact
